_about: Allowlist of prior input-file SHAs that are content-equivalent to a current SHA for scoring purposes. Consulted by tests/test_published_runs.py when a published run's recorded SHA does not match the live file. Each entry must document the diff and a verifying reviewer so a reader can audit why the equivalence holds.

1b2fe36f2d19971a4f66e9f47462bac75926b386.diff_summary: PR #31 (b31185f) dropped repair_prompt_named and repair_prompt_deictic fields from every task; a subsequent edit reclassified task-059 (oil filter) from sequential_task to object_in_hand per the shift_type precedence rule. shift_type is judge-only metadata used only for analysis bucketing — runner.py omits it from candidate and judge prompts — so per-task scoring is unchanged.

bd3611d20996a3b3d6a6a1d9c9833f36b5a287bb.diff_summary: Reclassified task-059 (oil filter) from sequential_task to object_in_hand per the shift_type precedence rule added to docs/task_authoring.md. The Turn 2 scene shows a different object in the hand (new filter) while the original sits in the catch basin, so object_in_hand takes precedence over sequential_task. shift_type is judge-only metadata used only for analysis bucketing — runner.py omits it from candidate and judge prompts — so per-task scoring is unchanged.
